title: Helicopter Tour of Vancouver City (Depart SKY Hangar)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Prepare for a journey that combines luxury, excitement, and breathtaking aerial views of one of the world's most beautiful cities, Vancouver. As you depart from our SKY Hangar, located close to Vancouver, you'll soar over lush greenery and picturesque landscapes before arriving in the heart of the city. Marvel at the iconic sights from a unique perspective—the towering peaks of the Coast Mountains, the vibrant downtown skyline, and the tranquil waters of Burrard Inlet.

Ideal for travellers seeking an unforgettable experience, our Vancouver City Tour offers unparalleled views and comfort. Relax in our state-of-the-art helicopters, equipped with panoramic windows for optimal viewing and plush seating for your comfort.

SINGLE PASSENGERS: We require a minimum of TWO purchased seats of any flight in order to depart. Our team will do their best to pair you up with other passengers but if you are the only passenger booked on a departure, SKY reserves the right to cancel your booking.
